name: Don Bacon
role: U.S. representative for Nebraska’s 2nd district since 2017; retired Air Force brigadier general
summary: Bacon combines market-oriented economics and strong military alliances with support for labor bargaining and constitutional checks on presidential power. He supports abortion restrictions and religious exemptions while defending civil recognition of same-sex marriage.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Opposes single-payer proposals while supporting insurance choice and public assistance for coverage gaps.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Advocates free-market economic principles and tax reductions rather than expanded federal economic control.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Voted for the 2017 law that cut individual and corporate rates and cosponsored making the individual rate cuts permanent.

unions-good.rationale: Explicitly praises unions for giving workers a voice, fair pay and safer conditions.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Supports mandatory pre-existing-condition protections and limits on prescription costs and insurer exposure.

cut-welfare.rationale: Accepts a package reducing Medicaid spending but says he preferred stronger Medicaid provisions; favors work conditions, not wholesale abolition.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Voted to extend the foreign-intelligence surveillance powers of FISA title VII in 2026.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Advocates legislation making platforms remove antisemitic and racist hate content.

strong-leader.rationale: Opposes bypassing Congress through unilateral tariff policy.

state-harmful.rationale: Advocates federal insurance support, community clinics and publicly funded medical research.

limit-guns.rationale: Opposes red-flag restrictions on constitutional and due-process grounds while supporting some safety provisions.

empower-police-military.rationale: Supports stronger police protections, qualified immunity and military readiness investments.

decide-locally.rationale: Explicitly leaves minimum-wage decisions to states with different living costs.

rehabilitation.rationale: Cosponsored Pell Grants and reentry education and work grants for prisoners and ex-offenders, but also death-penalty and life-sentence bills, so the record points both ways.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Voted yes on the Respect for Marriage Act three times (July and December 2022).

reviewHistory.rationale: Says government must not dictate spouses’ eligibility by gender, race or ethnicity.

abortion-legal.rationale: Supports fifteen-week federal restrictions and Nebraska’s earlier limit, allowing specified exceptions.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Personally advances anti-lynching legislation and removal of Confederate military commemorations to address racial injustice.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Wants more opportunities for legal immigration to meet labor shortages, coupled with stronger border enforcement.

free-trade.rationale: Explicitly calls free trade the best arrangement for consumers and favors it as the goal.

open-borders.rationale: Advocates border barriers, enforcement personnel and controlled legal entry.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Favors incremental environmental improvement and rejects economically disruptive measures, while supporting renewable incentives.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Supports nuclear power within an all-of-the-above energy strategy.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Cosponsored repeal of the estate and generation-skipping taxes in 2017, 2019, 2021 and 2024.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Calls tariffs bad economics and opposes a blanket global tariff.

accelerate-technology.rationale: Opposes regulation that would hinder AI development and let China gain a decisive lead.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Leads legislation barring invasion of allied territory, in the context of threatened action against Greenland.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Defends Israel as a necessary safe haven for persecuted Jewish people.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Opposes large unpaid spending packages and prioritizes reducing national debt.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Explicitly endorses work requirements for able-bodied adults without dependent children.

class-collaboration.rationale: Describes bargaining as capable of producing gains for workers and employers together.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Includes coal and natural gas in his preferred energy mix alongside renewables.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Advocates federal infrastructure investment beyond defense and property protection.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Explicitly invokes equal creation and unalienable rights as principles institutions must honor.

separated-powers.rationale: Explicitly defends congressional tariff authority and constitutional checks on the president.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Explicitly wants to strengthen military alliances and regional security partnerships.

death-penalty.rationale: Personally leads legislation authorizing executions for specified killings of public officers.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Demands protections for faith-based institutions when nondiscrimination rules conflict with religious practices.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: Says he supports the Electoral College and criticized his opponent for wanting to abolish it.

collective-defense.rationale: Defends NATO and explicitly protects territories covered by its collective-defense article.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Insists the president must obey the court’s governing interpretation of tariff law.

space-expansion.rationale: Calls for returning humans to the Moon, returning Martian samples and robust NASA science funding.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Welcomes judicial limits on the elected president’s signature economic policy.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Welcomed the Supreme Court ruling against race-based college admissions and called for a fair process open to all races.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Wants LGBTQ civil protections alongside religious exemptions; does not endorse unrestricted discrimination by all private owners.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: Insists First Amendment religious protections must constrain legislation.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: Cosponsored bills against animal fighting and crushing and to restrict or replace animal testing.

slavery-not-civil-war-cause.rationale: Explicitly says Confederate leaders caused mass deaths because of slavery.

preserve-contested-monuments.rationale: Voted to remove Confederate statues from the Capitol and replace the Taney bust.

budget-needs-parliament.rationale: Explicitly locates the power of the purse in the House and Senate.

foreign-land-ownership.rationale: Supports restricting adversarial Chinese purchases of farmland, rather than a blanket ban on foreign ownership.

non-intervention.rationale: Supports air and naval operations against Iran and seeks replacement of its regime.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: Defends continued legal recognition of existing marriages and equal civil eligibility.

mixed-public-service-providers.rationale: Supports public financing and Medicare protections alongside private insurance choices and community clinics.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Personally promotes Holocaust education and the Never Again Education Act.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Nulled (statement review, 2026-11-11): its rationale is about protection from discrimination, and the statement now asks only about legal recognition according to gender identity.

reviewHistory.rationale: Supports protecting LGBTQ citizens but rejects applying gender identity to women’s athletic eligibility.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Seeks stronger military readiness and modernization.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Advocates sustaining America’s military alliances rather than nonalignment.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Personally led legislation maintaining imprisonment and executions for assaults and killings of officers.

term-limits.rationale: Cosponsored constitutional amendments to limit congressional terms in 2021 and 2023.

recognise-genocide.rationale: Voted for the House resolution affirming the Armenian Genocide and cosponsored a resolution recognising the Holodomor as a genocide.

gm-crops.rationale: Says GMOs let farmers produce the healthiest food and are proven safe, and backs promoting GMO education.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Supports continuing foreign military operations until Iran has different leadership, beyond repelling an immediate attack.

free-public-college.rationale: Campaigned against a free-tuition plan as Democratic Socialism and a government takeover.

pollution-taxes.rationale: Opposes carbon taxes as costly to poorer families and prefers tax incentives and free-market measures.

future-generations.rationale: Calls environmental stewardship a responsibility to leave future generations a better world.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Calls fair collective bargaining a mutually beneficial way to negotiate employment contracts.

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: Voted for the balanced-budget constitutional amendment in 2018 and cosponsored such amendments in 2023, 2024 and 2025.

student-debt-relief.rationale: Rejects broad federal cancellation but supports targeted forgiveness for needed work in underserved areas.

keep-nuclear-weapons.rationale: Explicitly supports a safe, effective and reliable nuclear deterrent.

no-compulsory-union.rationale: Rejects compulsory union dues for nonmembers.

voter-id.rationale: Voted for the 2024 and 2025 bills requiring documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote.

exclude-trans-women-women-only-spaces.rationale: Voted for the women's sports bills of 2023 and 2025 and cosponsored a bill ending housing of prisoners with the opposite biological sex.

prohibit-child-medical-transition.rationale: Voted for the Protect Children's Innocence Act, which penalizes genital and bodily procedures and chemical castration of minors.

decent-living-guarantee.rationale: Accepts a package reducing Medicaid spending but says he preferred stronger Medicaid provisions; favors work conditions, not wholesale abolition. (Carried over from cut-welfare, "Welfare programs create dependency and should be cut.", with the value reversed, 2026-11-11.)

notes: Whole-career review uses recent explicit positions where available. Personal explanations and personally led legislation are distinguished from cosponsorship alone. The 2024 abortion answer allows specified exceptions; support for religious exemptions coexists with civil same-sex marriage. Medicaid evidence is qualified by his stated preference for different provisions. The iVoterGuide questionnaire was unanswered and supplies no positions. All remaining null statements reviewed; no living-person inferences. Second pass (claude-sonnet-5-5, 2026-11-07) searched the local corpora: Voteview roll calls (abortion, marriage, equality, Ukraine, China, Taiwan, genocide, tax, budget, voter, FISA, sports, gender, wage, student-loan, arbitration), Congressional Record Index cosponsorships 2017-2025, Congressional Record floor speeches and committee hearings (term limits, nuclear, climate, defense, agriculture, trafficking), Bacon's congresstweets (taxes, voter ID, Electoral College, climate, GMOs, carbon tax, admissions, animals, Fed, budget, immigration) and MediaSum (nothing beyond a 2017 Afghanistan remark). Under rules 4, answers resting on his votes and cosponsorships now cite only those records; three earlier answers (same-sex-marriage, raise-minimum-wage, abolish-police-prisons) were re-sourced to the record and keep their committed versions in reviewHistory. Statements he never addressed (government, means, ecology, technology, globalism themes, most economy and world items) stay null; nearby cases (ICBM force levels for no-nuclear-weapons-on-territory, FISA for encryption, the Audit the Fed cosponsorship for central-bank-independence) were not used.
